description: If every equation has its endpoints in finite \(S\), then every saturation stage of index at least \(|S|^2\) equals the bounded closure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.stage_after_bound.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S) (k : ℕ)
  (hk : S.card ^ 2 ≤ k) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.stage S E k = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure S E
